about: Predicted transits of the 665 counted candidates (tiers A, B, N, L1) of eumemic/exoplanets at commit 58c6318: candidates/ephemerides.csv and candidates/predictions.csv. tc0 = first predicted mid-transit (BJD_TDB) and e0 its epoch; P = period (days); s2 = [a, b, c] with 1-sigma^2 (min^2) = a + b k + c k^2, k = epochs after e0, fitted to every row of predictions.csv; depth (ppm), dur (hours), ra, dec (degrees). UTC at Earth's centre = BJD_TDB - 69.184 s - light time along Earth's position towards the star; checked against all 41176 published tc_UTC values (each within 9 s of its published minute) and sigmas (within 0.08 min). Predicted, not observed. Data CC BY 4.0, eumemic.
